description: Today's highest-scoring tickers as published on tapeline.io — the same rows an anonymous visitor sees, each with score, signal and the one-line reason.

max_missing.description: Optional. Only rows missing at most this many of the checks that apply to them (0 = every applicable check measured). With it set, the list is a filtered view, not the published top 10.

name: get_daily_picks
title: Get today's published top picks
